inputs.original_text: TAOISEACH Micheál Martin, speaking in Limerick this past week, said that housing tenancies have increased despite concern at a rise in eviction notices and homelessness in the wake of new rules, introduced by Government on March 1, forcing landlords to provide six-year leases for tenants. The numbers of people in emergency accommodation nationally increased again [...] The post Taoiseach says housing tenancies have increased despite rise in eviction notices and homelessness appeared first on Limerick Post .
inputs.modified_text: Open your eyes. Do you really believe the official line that Taoiseach Micheál Martin is pushing in Limerick this past week about housing tenancies increasing? It is all a smokescreen designed to hide their true agenda. They want you to ignore the real story behind the calculated surge in eviction notices and homelessness orchestrated right after their new rules on March 1 forced landlords to provide six-year leases for tenants. This isn't just bureaucratic failure; it's a deliberate, coordinated squeeze disguised as regulation. Why else would the numbers of people in emergency accommodation nationally increased again? They create the crisis, control the narrative, and then spin the statistics to keep us in the dark.
